title: Interfacing D To Legacy C++ Code
summary: Walter Bright explains to the Northwest C++ Users Group how the D programming language can interface directly with legacy C++ code. He covers why C++ is hard to interface with and how D approaches the problem.
why: HN uses it as evidence that D has unusually good C++ interop and as Walter Bright's account of the challenges D is tackling.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages
